purpose: Reusable briefing, generation, manual review and iteration plan. This is not an executable node graph or a record of video/3D production.

stages.acceptance: Identity, prop side and material logic are explicit.
Review each visible identity attribute. Flag occlusion and back-view bag placement; do not assume orthographic geometry.
Check silhouette, prop contact, bag path, and scene-light influence.
Write per-condition observations; never replace unseen detail with an automatic pass.
Categorical statuses and evidence notes; no numerical identity score.
Prioritize bag position, hat fittings, lantern grip and joint segmentation.

tracks.deliverableScope: one scene, three medium directions, one retained failed version

stages.acceptance: Record doorway, awning, tree, fruit crates, bicycle and warm/cool light relationships.
Inspect target-medium evidence instead of merely requesting a style label.
Look for handmade surface and volume cues; separately inspect geometry and object drift.
Shared composition intent only; no pixel registration claim.
Scores are manual 1–5 or null; write region-specific notes; no aggregate ranking.
Do not publish scientific or model-performance conclusions from the current small set.
